title: DOM and rendering tree
description: Separate the document object model from what the browser paints, then create safe interface updates with DOM methods instead of interpreting learner input as HTML.
objectives: Distinguish DOM nodes, style calculation, layout and paint
Use createElement and textContent for user-provided text
Replace displayed content without injecting markup
Verify the actual rendered behavior and keyboard input
rubric: I separated DOM operations from layout and paint concepts.
I tested a markup-looking input and observed literal text, not parsed HTML.
I verified native button keyboard activation and no external submission.
